name: Anneliese Schmidt
bio:
Anneliese's path to motorsport began unexpectedly. After completing her apprenticeship in automotive engineering, she found herself drawn to the precision and high-stakes environment of racing, specifically the intricacies of composite materials. She quickly demonstrated a natural aptitude for the craft, mastering the complex processes of layup, curing, and inspection. Her dedication and meticulous attention to detail earned her a position with ART Grand Prix Academy where she has become a vital member of the team.

Anneliese approaches her role with unwavering commitment, ensuring every component she works on meets the highest standards of quality and performance. She is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to troubleshoot even the most complex issues. Her colleagues appreciate her willingness to share her knowledge and expertise, making her a valuable mentor to junior technicians. Anneliese is distinguished by her focus; she can spend hours focusing on the smallest detail to ensure it is perfect, a trait that has saved the team valuable time and resources on multiple occasions.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled in a low bun, with a few stray strands framing her face.
physical.description: Anneliese is a woman of average height with a focused, determined expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Insists on using a specific brand of calipers for all measurements.
Frequently hums classical music while working, a habit that she claims helps her maintain focus.
